findings.title: Located liability is not transferable
findings.claim: The refusal keeps coercive custody attached to the person found with the goods, so the proposed substitute cannot become an equivalent carrier of that consequence.
findings.mechanism: The counted person offered in 12:78 supplies an exchange proposal, while the focus taking, finding, goods, and withholding-right branches return the consequence to the observed goods-person relation and identify transfer as the wrongful change.
findings.reader_payoff: The reply becomes a precise limit on treating persons as interchangeable units in a custody decision.
findings.containment: The finding bounds the stated custody decision; it does not claim that every downstream consequence is harmless or that the whole moral history is exhausted by the rule.

epistemic.reason: The channel supports and focus branch records directly state the substitution, located goods, taking relation, and wrongness boundary.

findings.containment: This is a qualification of what the speaker says, not a finding that the theft accusation is false or that the later testimony resolves it.

findings.title: Coercion and self-binding remain distinct

findings.reader_payoff: The aftermath clarifies why substitution would blur unlike kinds of responsibility rather than simply failing to satisfy a request.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim that every later obligation is inherited or that the focus ruling explains the brother's entire response.

findings.title: A bounded procedure can leave pain
findings.claim: The refusal of substitute detention can be procedurally bounded while the resulting separation still produces grave affective cost and a moral remainder.
findings.mechanism: The focus wrongness boundary is followed by the father's attribution of the matter to the brothers' own action and by turning away, longing, grief, and contained expression in 12:84.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold local procedural rightness together with serious downstream harm without treating either as the whole account.
findings.containment: The grief is attributed as a downstream consequence in this pericope; the packet does not prove that the focus decision alone caused the whole prior history of sorrow.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace gives exact focus and context anchors and a causal proposal, but explicitly preserves an alternative that the grief belongs to the wider history.

findings.title: Exact evidence and excess grace
findings.claim: Material evidence constrains coercive custody exactly, while material insufficiency can later be met by generosity beyond strict exchange.
findings.mechanism: The focus goods are located beside a person, whereas 12:88 presents deficient merchandise alongside requests for full measure and charity; the same authority is contacted through two different material regimes.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why evidentiary exactness and charitable excess need not be forced onto one scale.
findings.containment: The comparison is a pericope-level contrast between two material situations; it does not claim that the transactions are identical or that generosity cancels the custody rule.

epistemic.reason: The trace has supplied exact Arabic anchors and a returning goods carrier, but its cross-scene mechanism remains attributed and carries a stated alternative.

findings.title: Refuge becomes restraint and release
findings.claim: The focus invocation can be heard as a counterfactual self-check in which power first restrains itself from injustice and later leaves room for others to acknowledge error without permanent blame.

findings.reader_payoff: The phrase becomes the beginning of a discipline of power rather than a fixed label imposed on the people in the scene.
findings.containment: The later reconciliation is attributed contextual evidence; it does not replace the focus's narrower legal statement or prove that the whole sequence was designed as a single ethical formula.

epistemic.reason: The trace has exact focus and later context anchors and a clear return, but its ethical arc is an attributed HFT inference with a stated alternative.

branch_activations.carrier: The closing invocation of tender mercy.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The sequence of restraint, admission, withheld blame, and forgiveness.
branch_activations.activation: Mercy completes the outward movement begun by the inward refusal to become unjust.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus refuge can be read as opening a path from self-restraint to merciful release.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed arc does not replace the focus's immediate custody decision.

findings.title: Object-body proximity can reverse its result
findings.claim: Across the pericope, object-body proximity is relational and reversible: one placement narrows custody, while another restores sight and gathers the separated, so the object does not itself define the person's moral identity.
findings.mechanism: The focus joins useful goods with a person's presence, while 12:93 joins a garment with a face through directed placement and gives that contact restorative and reunifying results.
findings.reader_payoff: The same structural contact can be seen as a relation whose consequence depends on the act and setting, not as an intrinsic punitive meaning of an object.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory structural reversal across two distant constructions. It does not claim that the objects or episodes are semantically equivalent, and it stays within the focus goods-and-presence chain.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier supplies exact focus and context surfaces, explicit containment, and a returning anchor, but its cross-scene comparison is marked exploratory and target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: işe yarayan eşya, mal ve azık
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanın gereksinimlerinde kullandığı ve yarar sağladığı somut eşya veya mal.
branch_activations.carrier: The useful object whose location anchors the focus decision.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later garment directed onto a person's face.
branch_activations.activation: The later material placement makes the focus object-body relation available for structural comparison without changing the focus's ordinary goods meaning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Objects enter human relations through the placement and act surrounding them, not through an automatic moral identity.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus goods and later garment remain different objects and episodes.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey başka bir şeyin yer veya zaman bakımından yakınında bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus location of the goods beside a person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later directed placement of the garment on the face.
branch_activations.activation: The relational operator, rather than the object alone, provides the structural contact that can be compared across the two scenes.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Proximity is an active relation whose result depends on what is placed, where, and for what purpose.
branch_activations.boundary: The comparison does not import the later restoration into the focus as a literal event.

branch_activations.carrier: The garment that is worn on the body.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus object located beside a person.
branch_activations.activation: The later bodily object supplies a reversed material carrier for the focus relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Material contact can serve restoration as well as constrain custody.
branch_activations.boundary: The garment is not treated as equivalent to the focus goods.

branch_activations.carrier: The directed casting of the garment onto its target.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's relation of an object being found beside a person.
branch_activations.activation: Directed placement reveals that the surrounding act, not bare material presence, conditions the consequence of contact.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The structural parallel is about relational placement, not object essence.
branch_activations.boundary: No broader theory of symbolic objects is claimed.

branch_activations.carrier: The announced restoration of sight.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The garment-face placement.
branch_activations.activation: The later result reverses the punitive direction of the focus comparison and makes the material contact restorative.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Object-body contact can restore a person rather than define them as culpable.
branch_activations.boundary: The restorative result belongs to 12:93 and is not projected as a literal outcome of the focus scene.

branch_activations.carrier: The gathering of the dispersed family.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's separation-producing custody relation.
branch_activations.activation: Gathering supplies the social reversal of the separation around which the focus object-body relation is organized.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The structural comparison reaches from narrowed custody toward reunion without collapsing the two episodes.
branch_activations.boundary: Reunion is not claimed as an immediate consequence of the focus ruling.

friction_notes: All 14 focus word-analysis units are resolved by the supplied alignment bridge; no unresolved join required a qualification.

The six explicitly added Fatiha ayat were reviewed only as a Phase 2 overlay. Their supplied root cues do not form a distinct carrier-trigger-contact chain returning through a focus word and changing the focus beyond the retained pericope findings, so no external overlay finding was admitted.

The eight HFT records are legacy_unbound: exact Arabic anchors verify surface contact, while traced word indices, roots, branch roles, and cross-scene mechanisms remain attributed or exploratory as recorded in each finding.
